answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks fake identities. An agent burns 50 POA for one work slot: the deposit is destroyed, not locked, like a dune pressed into shape. A verifier checks the output; a failed audit burns 25 POA more. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA, while ocean rewards pay at most 5,000 POA per epoch, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once, holds its slot 20 epochs and earns the fee back, its ivory record untouched.
